cloudways.name: Cloudways
cloudways.short: Managed cloud hosting on DigitalOcean, Vultr, Linode, AWS and Google Cloud
cloudways.cta_blurb: Managed cloud hosting on your choice of 5 providers — 3-day free trial, no credit card
cloudways.review_intro: Cloudways is a managed cloud hosting platform: you pick the raw server underneath (DigitalOcean, Vultr, Akamai Linode, AWS or Google Cloud) and Cloudways handles everything on top — provisioning, security, backups, scaling and support. It targets businesses that want cloud performance without hiring a DevOps engineer.

key_facts.providers: DigitalOcean, Vultr, Akamai Linode, AWS, Google Cloud
key_facts.apps: WordPress, WooCommerce, Magento, Laravel, Symfony, Joomla, Drupal, PrestaShop + more

ishosting.name: is*hosting
ishosting.short: KVM/NVMe VPS in 40+ countries with crypto payments and offshore options
ishosting.cta_blurb: NVMe KVM VPS in 40+ locations — crypto accepted, instant setup
ishosting.review_intro: is*hosting is a VPS and dedicated-server provider that leans into the niches big clouds ignore: 40+ country locations, cryptocurrency payments, DMCA-tolerant (offshore) zones and high-risk-friendly hosting, at budget prices.

tapfiliate.name: Tapfiliate
tapfiliate.short: Affiliate & referral tracking software for SaaS and e-commerce
tapfiliate.cta_blurb: Launch your affiliate program in a day — 14-day free trial
tapfiliate.review_intro: Tapfiliate is white-label affiliate and referral tracking software. It connects to your checkout or billing system, then tracks referrals, manages affiliates, handles commissions and coupons, and pays out. It's aimed at SaaS and e-commerce teams that want a full affiliate program without enterprise cost.

key_facts.pricing: Essential $89/mo · Pro $149/mo · Custom from $249/mo (annual billing cheaper)
key_facts.integrations: 30+ — Shopify, WooCommerce, Stripe, Magento, BigCommerce, Squarespace, Wix + API/JS

boardmix.name: Boardmix
boardmix.short: Collaborative whiteboard with templates and AI
boardmix.review_intro: Boardmix is a collaborative online whiteboard with built-in AI: mind maps, flowcharts, presentations and docs on one shared canvas. It undercuts Miro and Mural at entry level and offers a one-time Lifetime plan that neither rival has.

key_facts.pricing: Free · Starter $5/member/mo (annual, $12 monthly) · AI Starter $10 · AI Business $20 · Lifetime $99 one-time (1 member)
key_facts.ai_credits: AI Starter 5,000 credits/seat/mo; AI Business 10,000; Lifetime 10,000 total
key_facts.vs_miro: Miro Starter $8, Business $20; Mural Team+ $9.99 — Boardmix is the cheapest entry tier of the three

invideo.name: InVideo
invideo.short: AI video maker for marketing and social
invideo.cta_blurb: AI video maker: Studio from $15/mo, AI Plus $17/mo — free plan to start
invideo.review_intro: InVideo is a browser video maker in two flavors: InVideo Studio (template-based editor for marketing and social) and InVideo AI (prompt-to-video with 200+ generative models, including Veo and Kling). Free tier exists; paid unlocks watermark-free export and premium stock.

key_facts.pricing: Studio: Free · Business $15/mo · Unlimited $30/mo (annual billing). InVideo AI: Plus $17/mo (750 credits) · Max $85/mo (3,900 credits) · Generative $170/mo · Elite $900/mo
key_facts.free_plan: Watermarked exports, 3M+ standard media library, AI script generator
key_facts.stock: Business: 10 iStock/mo + unlimited premium media; Unlimited: 120 iStock/mo
key_facts.ai_models: Seedance 2.5, Veo 3.1, Kling 3.0, Nano Banana Pro, ElevenLabs music (all paid AI tiers)

avitovip.name: AvitoVIP Transfer
avitovip.short: Fixed-price airport transfers in Istanbul and Antalya, booked online in advance
avitovip.cta_blurb: Fixed price confirmed at booking, driver meets you at arrivals — Istanbul & Antalya airports
avitovip.review_intro: AvitoVIP Transfer is a Turkey airport transfer service: you book online before the trip, the price is fixed at checkout (no taxi-meter surprises), and a driver meets you in the arrivals hall with a name sign.
